items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL beads aspirated from beads_reservoir A1 and dispensed into each of the 96 wells, followed by 10 mix cycles of 70 uL, and a protocol.comment for the 5 min incubation precedes the magnet comment.

The engage-magnet comment (wait 5 min) comes first, then log shows 90 uL aspirated from each of the 96 wells to waste A1, and two rounds of 200 uL ethanol added and each fully removed (200 uL) to waste.
Comments record the 5 min dry, magnet disengage, 50 uL water added to each well with 10 mix cycles of 40 uL, then the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage before the transfer.
Log shows 45 uL aspirated from each sample_plate well and dispensed into the same-named elution_plate well, A1 through H12.
Log shows pick up tip and drop tip around every single-well transfer in supernatant removal, both ethanol removals, and elution, so no tip touches two samples.

judge.summary: The simulator log shows every step done with correct volumes, well pairing and a fresh tip per sample. Incubation, magnet, and drying steps are recorded as protocol.comment calls at the right points, as the task requires.
